body: Sharan Bansal (Director / ED) on 2025-04-30 (Q4FY25 concall transcript): "We will be adding a further amount of 75,000 tons this year also." Metric: Second +75k t capacity. Target: 450k t total. Deadline: 2026-03-31. Specificity: precise; prompted by analyst. Status as of 2026-11-19: missed. Evidence: Not commissioned in FY26. Dates given since: Mar-26 -> 'spill over to Q1' (Jan-26) -> June-26 (Apr-26) -> H2FY27 / end-Q2 (Aug-26) -> end-Q3 or early Q4 FY27 (Oct-26). Not operational as of the Oct-26 call. Explanation given: 'as like any capex project ... minor delays' (Jan-26, prompted)
